name: Covariance Splat Reading
definition: A method to read a single 3D Gaussian Splat in covariance representation from two texture arrays, decoding its properties into a CovSplat struct.
summary: Covariance Splat Reading decodes a single 3D Gaussian Splat from compressed texture arrays into a structured representation, differing from raw buffer access by using specific unpacking logic to reconstruct continuous covariance components.
